EGY.note: Training press release; states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
States nothing on AI used in government administration.
States nothing on AI inside a public sector system.
AI is only a training track; no AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
Trainees are students and graduates, not civil servants.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology says its Digital Egypt Generations initiatives trained over 220,000 people in 2024, of whom more than 122,000 had graduated, free of charge and open to ages 8 to 88 nationwide.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

EGY.note: States no school internet share and no compulsory secondary digital subject.
